description: chat-macros that read the tail of chat history: {{lastUserMessage}} / {{lastCharMessage}} / {{lastMessage}} / {{lastMessageId}}. Also tests that swipes are ignored (we only read the active mes).

messages.name: Bob
messages.mes: Hi Alice, what time does the library close?

messages.name: Alice
messages.mes: We close at midnight, but I rarely leave on time.

messages.name: Bob
messages.mes: Mind if I stay a bit longer to finish a chapter?

messages.name: Alice
messages.mes: Of course. Just don't tell the night guard.
